notes.title: A New Beginning
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that [b]the extended prologue is now live![/b] Start a new game to experience the day leading up to your fateful encounter at the Griswald mansion 👻

Changelog for 04/15/2025 update:
- Added a new tutorial stage that contains two optional minigames, which also functions as the prologue for the game's story
- Added new content to the beginning of one ending route
- Added a new achievement that can only be unlocked during the prologue of the game

Additionally, the [b]demo version of MimiCries has been updated[/b] to include all the current mechanics and assets from the base game. 

[i]Thank you as always for your support and hope you enjoy the new prologue![/i]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes and Changes #03
notes.content:
We're glad to see that some of you who have tried our game have liked it!

We've taken note of some of the feedback and bugs that were faced while playing MimiCries and have pushed out fixes for it. Check the Changelog section to see a more detailed list of fixes.

Changelog for 02/28/2024 update:
- Added flavor text interaction point in Lord Griswald's Bedchamber
- Changed a line of flavor text during a sequence that occurs in the Bedroom of the Daughter
- Enhanced the visibility of a textual clue that is found in the Bedroom of the Daughter
- Fixed a pop up image not disappearing after its interaction in the Dinner Banquet Room
- Fixed a bug in The Lord's Study whereby a sound persists after Game Over and requires the game to be restarted.

Upcoming Changes:
- We have enabled 1 achievement icon which is visible but not working. We're doing our best to implement all the achievements and ensure that it is working before making them live. 

Thank you for your continued support and patience.

notes.title: MimiCries First Release has been confirmed!
notes.content:
We've come a long way since the beginning of development on MimiCries since the start of 2023, and we're quite excited to inform all of you that we've finally hit a major milestone...

The launch version of MimiCries will be releasing a week from now, on the 14th of February 2024! 

As part of the launch release, you may look forward to:
- A total of five different puzzle rooms throughout the game
- A new addition of a path which leads to a game clear sequence

We've also opted to refine our graphics in multiple areas in our game, notably, the title screen and the game over screen visuals.

But don't think this upcoming update will be the last from us, we will have more in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/ddaf901c37d087002aac3c923c1a8b0293ca7267.png[/img][h2]"The Griswald Mansion beckons..."  [/h2]

notes.content:

- Minor spelling errors

notes.title: Game Updates for Friday the 13th!
notes.content:
Seeing that Friday the 13th falls on spooky month this year, we’ve decided to release a new puzzle as part of the continuation of the MimiCries storyline. 

We’ve also added some quality of life changes to the game;
- Hints collected throughout the game will be displayed in the inventory
- Some rooms that were previously locked are now accessible at the start of the game 
- Additional atmospheric lighting effects

We have also updated the game with some additional comfort changes, slightly more hints included in areas where it was difficult to determine clues, such as in the first puzzle, where there is a guide to help check if you've explored the area properly.

1 new puzzle stage has been released, which extends the playtime by about an hour, including a new character and their lore associated with them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/bc003441aee61d0c793c5e3f4d165774653d2f65.gif[/img]

notes.title: MimiCries October Update!
notes.content:
Hi, 

It’s been awhile. 
We have a couple of updates for MimiCries.

[b]Early Access Updates for October[/b]

On [u]Friday the 13th[/u], we’ll be releasing a new puzzle as part of the continuation of the MimiCries storyline. 

Also, we’re adding some quality of life changes to the game;
- Hints collected throughout the game will be displayed in the inventory
- Some rooms that were previously locked are now accessible at the start of the game 
- Additional lighting effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/395588de2010598ad1546540fe00b07a5419feed.png[/img]

[b]Participation in Steam Scream [/b]

We are excited to announce that we have been invited to join the Steam Scream sales happening from October 27th to November 3rd. 

MimiCries will be on a [i]30% discount[/i] during this period. 

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

[b]Release date update[/b]

Last but not least, we would like to announce that the full game will be released some time in Mid-December 2023. For those who have purchased the early access, your version of the game will automatically be updated to the full version upon release.

Cheers!
